correctness.rationale: The exact operator norm is the supremum of the two Lagrange-basis moduli because continuous unit-disk interpolation extends prescribed node phases. The three-branch circular-chord identity yields lower bounds sec d and sin(theta/2)/sin d for every asymmetric pair; centered pairs attain their maximum exactly. One branch strictly increases, the other strictly decreases, meeting uniquely at tan d=sin(theta/2). A small strict exterior displacement forbids every nonzero midpoint at this separation. Domain and endpoint limits are explicit. The standard-library checker passed 4,539 finite diagnostic assertions, not used to infer the universal theorem.

value.rationale: It solves a natural continuum-parameter exact conditioning minimax for the newly studied E_theta Banach function planes, with unique optimal sampling geometry rather than an arbitrary data slice. Strictly inward optimal nodes are forced for every arc length. In near-full-circle arcs endpoint interpolation diverges while optimal interpolation stays bounded by sqrt(2), yielding a motivated structural sampling conclusion not supplied by conventional generic interpolation upper bounds.
